description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016317831 CAP-PLUG,PROTECTIVE: Line 0001 Qty 8 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0046 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
